name: dashboard
description: A pane beside the Claude Code chat: what each message changed (files, +/− lines, diff, click to open in your editor) and the texts Claude writes for you to paste, one key each.

language.title: Language
language.description: Labels of the pane. auto: Claude Code's language setting, else the system locale (English unless Italian).

editor.title: Editor command
editor.description: Command that opens a changed file, with {file} and {line}, e.g. code -g {file}:{line}. Empty: the editor the session runs in (Antigravity, VS Code, Cursor, VSCodium), else the system opener.
